name: Project Atlas
goal: Launch a lightweight B2B service pilot and validate repeatable demand.
strategy: Start with a narrow customer segment, test pricing, then scale only after repeatable conversion.

decisions.decision: Keep the pilot limited to one customer segment.
decisions.reason: A narrower scope should make pricing and conversion signals easier to interpret.

decisions.decision: Test two pricing options before expanding scope.
decisions.reason: Pricing uncertainty is currently a larger risk than feature depth.

name: Client Portal
goal: Reduce manual client support through a self-service portal.
strategy: Ship a small pilot with the highest-frequency client requests first.

decisions.decision: Pilot only the three most common request types.
decisions.reason: This keeps the first release small enough to validate adoption quickly.
